daily_report_endpoint.description: GET /api/health/daily-report returns 200 with daily_plan field containing objectives

activity_data_in_report.description: Data object contains steps, calories, distance_km fields (0 for user without bracelet)

morning_briefing_endpoint.description: GET /api/nora/morning-briefing returns 200 with user_name, health, nora_message, objectives, streak, has_data

checkin_daily_endpoint.description: POST /api/nora/checkin-daily returns 200 with status, streak, max_streak, badges

activity_card_navigation.description: Activity card navigates to /health-detail?metricId=activity on click
